title: A pause is no timeout in Codex work retrospectives
text: When a card finishes, Obeya reviews the worker's run for friction and suggests improvements to the repository's setup. For Codex workers, a command killed because the owner paused the card looked like a failed command, so the retrospective suggested a longer timeout that Codex doesn't even have. Now the excerpt recognises the pause, stop or restart, marks where it happened, and reports no friction for it.
